Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't leave the battle area. DNA digivolution results in a digivolution into a new Digimon that is considered a different Digimon from the one that would leave the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and DNA digivolve using 2 Digimon including one that would leave the battle area, does the DNA digivolved Digimon leave the battle area?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon's attack target can't change.
